messages:
Maria: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — large spike in 5xx and TLS handshake failures across prod eu-west gateways, started ~2026-03-15T12:34Z. Sample error: \"tls: handshake failure (ocsp responder returned 401)\". Rolling 5m: ~2.1k 5xx, 74% from eu-west.
Eng-SRE-Bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-ocsp-unauthorized. Pager duty: Maria -> Jordan.
Maria: Ack. I'm diving in. Front proxies are returning immediate 502/524s when attempts to validate stapled OCSP. Client SDKs report connection errors.
Tim (Customer Success): CS seeing a high volume of tickets from EU customers; one enterprise reports complete failure since ~12:35Z. Need quick ETA for customers.
Jordan: Looking at gateway logs: repeating errors: \"OCSP responder returned 401 Unauthorized\", \"staple absent\" and timeouts. Curling the OCSP endpoint from a gateway pod returns 401 and indicates missing auth header.
Sophie: Any recent cert or CA rotations? If not, could be a network path or header injection issue. I'll check cert-manager events and controller logs.
Maria: No cert rotations scheduled. We had a networking change at ~12:30Z (change sg-change-20260315) — could be related.
Jordan: Probe from pod:
```
kubectl exec -n gateway pod/gw-eu-41 -- curl -i https://ocsp.ca-example.com/status
# HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\n# body: {\"error\":\"missing auth token\"}
```
Jordan: Tracing egress shows a proxy that usually injects X-OCSP-Auth header is bypassed after the SG change. OCSP server requires that header; without it they return 401.
Maria: Immediate mitigations brainstorm:
- enable temporary offline OCSP fallback on a small canary set to restore traffic quickly (risk: reduced security)
- rollback networking SG change to restore header injection (risk: broader network impact unless coordinated)
- work with CA to accept unsigned probes (slow / depends on vendor)
Sophie: We should canary fallback first to reduce customer pain while infra validates rollback plan.
Maria: Doing canary: apply config change on two eu-west gateways.
```
# apply canary fallback
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-ocsp-fallback
  namespace: gateway
data:
  ocsp_mode: "allow_offline_canary"
EOF
```
DeployBot: Deploy started: configmap/gateway-ocsp-fallback updated (canary nodes: gw-eu-41, gw-eu-42).
Maria: Canaries flipped. Monitoring metrics now.
(4m later)
Maria: Canary nodes show successful handshakes and 5xx for those nodes dropped dramatically. Total eu-west 5xx from 74% down to 20% on canary nodes signal.
Jordan: Reproduced the 401 in staging by applying the SG change there — confirmed missing header. We'll coordinate a controlled rollback.
Networking-Bot: Rolling back SG change sg-change-20260315 in prod upon approval. Expect short window ~5-10m to propagate.
Tim (Customer Success): CS updated affected customers: canary mitigation applied; we are expanding while we coordinate rollback. Customers asked for expected full recovery ETA. I shared ~30m preliminary.
Maria: Plan: expand fallback across eu-west to restore traffic now, then perform controlled SG rollback to fully restore strict OCSP. We'll re-enable strict checks after rollback.
Sophie: Rolling expansion with 20s stagger across nodes to avoid thundering herd.
Maria: Commands used:
```
kubectl label nodes gw-eu-* ocsp-fallback=enabled
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway-eu -n gateway
```
DeployBot: RollingUpdate started for gateway-eu.
(12m later)
Maria: Expansion complete; eu-west 5xx returned to baseline. CS reports reduced customer errors.
Jordan: SG rollback in progress. Coordinating with networking to ensure no unintended path regressions.
Networking-Bot: Revert applied: sg-change-20260315 rolled back at 13:05Z.
Jordan: Post-rollback checks: OCSP probe now returning 200 with expected header present:
```
curl -i -H "X-OCSP-Auth: token123" https://ocsp.ca-example.com/status
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
Maria: Good. Proceed to re-enable strict OCSP verification. Sophie, please run strict rollout.
Sophie: Applying strict config and rolling restarts (stagger 30s).
DeployBot: Re-enable rollout started for gateway-eu.
(6m later)
Maria: Strict mode restored across eu-west. Monitoring shows stable 2xx and no increase in 5xx.
Tim (Customer Success): Final customer update sent: root cause likely networking SG change that prevented auth header injection to OCSP responder causing 401s which led to handshake failures. Service restored; RCA and postmortem forthcoming.
Jordan: Incident timeline for record:
- 12:30Z apply sg-change-20260315
- 12:34Z spike TLS handshake failures
- 12:36Z incident paged
- 12:42Z canary fallback applied
- 12:55Z eu-west fallback expanded
- 13:05Z SG rollback completed
- 13:12Z strict OCSP re-enabled, system healthy
Maria: Impact summary: approximate 2.1k 5xx total, peak error rate ~17% of eu-west traffic, ~40 minutes to full recovery. Affected: hosted API endpoints and Dedicated customers pinned to eu-west.
Sophie: Postmortem action items (owners):
- P1: Add OCSP egress preflight tests to detect 4xx/401s after networking changes (Jordan)
- P1: Implement automated short-term fallback circuit for OCSP to minimize customer impact (Maria)
- P2: Strengthen SG change guardrails and add post-change connectivity smoke tests for OCSP flows (Networking)
- P3: Update CS incident template for TLS/OCSP messaging (Tim)
Maria: Handoff: Sophie will lead RCA write-up. I'll file incident INC-20260315-ocsp-unauthorized and tag owners.
Sophie: Acknowledged. I'll collect logs, probe scripts, and timing artifacts and draft the postmortem. Links:
- logs: https://logs.internal/prod/gateway/1762104321
- deploy: https://deploys.internal/changes/sg-change-20260315
Maria: Thanks all — incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
Eng-SRE-Bot: Incident INC-20260315-ocsp-unauthorized marked RESOLVED by Maria at 2026-03-15T13:20:30Z
